It's time to honor the greatest in the LCS! The LCS Summer Split Awards recognize players and coaches who showcased remarkable performance throughout the Summer Split and all year long. Stakes are rising as teams head closer to the LCS Championship Driven by Kia in Duluth, Georgia. If you haven’tgrabbed your tickets, there’s still time!

Fans can cast their ballots for Kia All-Pro Teams, Kia Summer Split MVP, and Kia Rookie of the Year at kialcsfanvote.com fromSeptember 4-13.

Each Split, the LCS honors the most exceptional talent across the league. These awards recognize the coaches and players whose performance, mechanics, and teamwork stood out at the highest level of play in League of Legends.

Ballots open September 6-9 for the 2026 LCS Summer Split. The fan ballots open September 4-13.

The North American Challengers League – North America’sLeague of LegendsTier 2 system – is in its home stretch.

Six teams remain in the NACL Summer Playoffs, but the prize isn’t merely a trophy. The top two teams qualify for the League Championship Series’ promotion-relegation tournament, set to happen later this year.

The finalists in the NACL Playoffs will join a pair of Liga Regional Norte teams and current LCS guest spot holder Disguised in a five-team event to qualify for North America’s Tier 1 system.

The lure of playing on stage in the LCS is enough to excite Cupid Esports coach Samuel “boc” Boudrie and his players.
